The '''Socorran Navy''' was the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] belonging to the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].

The crimelord [[Saadoon-Kauldi]], an ally to the government, lived in the ship ''[[Merkel]]'' orbiting the planet [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]] in the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]]. The Socorran Navy had orders to attack any unauthorized ship approaching the ''Merkel.''
